text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Racecourse is full of
excitement after
the race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Great run, Bourbon! Awesome job!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
But she's got the Kikuka Sho next, you
know. It'd
be great if she could pull off
3,000 meters, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Since she's already lost her chance at
winning the
Triple Crown, maybe she
won't run in it at all...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shut it! Our Bourbon's gonna stay
the course
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reporting. I have come in first place. I
have
completed my mission, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She didn't have a bad run... but her
dreams of
getting the Classic Triple
Crown are out the
window.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Kikuka Sho too. It'd be great
if she
could pull off 3,000 meters, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Since she's already lost her chance at
winning the
Triple Crown, maybe she
won't run in it at all...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shut it! Our Bourbon's gonna stay
the course
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reporting. I failed to place. I am very
sorry,
Trainer.
Mihono Bourbon suddenly falls silent.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Detecting unknown phenomenon.
Current goal of
attaining the Triple
Crown has been invalidated.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even if I continue the Twinkle Series,
obtaining
the Classic Triple Crown will
remain unachievable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I feel a contradiction within
myself.

She speaks slowly, as if unable to find
the right
words.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't achieve the Triple
Crown...
I still
want to run in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have yet to successfully run a full
3,000 meters,
but I wish to complete
this distance in a G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is my "desire." Is that acceptable,
Trainer?

I don't even need to think about how to
answer
after hearing her impassioned
words. I nod
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all in the 'Kiku...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order acknowledged!

As we renew our conviction to run in the
Kikuka
Sho...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on your lack of focus and unstable
footing, I have confirmed that you are
completely
exhausted. Are you...
"okay"?

Rice Shower mumbles her answer in a
daze,
making me wonder if she really
heard what
Mihono Bourbon said.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... I haven't caught up to you yet!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Caught up?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're so... amazing... I have to keep...
working...
harder...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I have to... work... even harder... I have
to...
change...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...

We bring Rice Shower somewhere safe
and make
sure she's awake before we
leave the Tokyo
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. I cannot understand Rice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Why is she so fixated upon me? Why
does she
wish to "catch up" to me?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In a race,
the result is either "victory" or
"defeat." Rice, however, doesn't focus
on either of those
outcomes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
She only expresses a desire to "catch
up." That is
the reason she runs.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If her definition of "catching up" differs
from the
term's typical meaning...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Then what is her real intention? I am
unable to
understand what she is running
for.

Every runner puts their own feelings into
races.
There are some who don't place
much importance
on winning.

You can only truly understand an
emotion after
you've experienced it for
yourself.

Mihono Bourbon's grasp on emotions is
tenuous at best, so Rice Shower's
feelings are likely even
harder for her to
comprehend.

I'm certain we'll continue to face off
against Rice
Shower in the Twinkle
Series.
choice_data_list: I'm sure the day will come when yo...

text_block_list.text:
I tell Mihono Bourbon there's no rush.
She'll
understand someday, so she just
needs to wait.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The basis of your statement is unclear,
but if that is your opinion, then I
determine it is worth
putting into
practice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will wait for the day that I understand.

The train quietly moves toward the
academy.

Next up is the final race in the Classic
Triple
Crown—the Kikuka Sho!
